package.name: openarmx_tof_driver
package.description: Hardware-layer TOF(Time Of Flight) sensor transport driver. Reads the ESP32-C3(VL53L0X) ToF2CAN board over USB-CDC serial (/dev/ttyACM0) and republishes the range as sensor_msgs/Range on /tof/range. Transport-only: any consumer (e.g. place_box_detection wall gate) subscribes to /tof/range and does not care how it is produced. Device firmware lives in firmware/.
